description: First - the location: a non-busy cul-de-sac in Paia’s Skill Village. This is the Upper West Side of the neighborhood, bordering Mahi Pono lands (read: large swaths of open agricultural lands out to the blue Pacific north shore of Maui). Paia Town, Baldwin Beach, and Ho’okipa Beach Park are nearby. The back yard is completely gated for a pet and/or escape-prone kiddos. It’s large and wonderful for playing, watching the sunset, bbq’s, etc. There’s a driving gate accessing the back yard also. The home: 4 bedrooms with ocean and mountain views. There are various potential rental configurations. One of the bedrooms could be used as a rental lock-off, with it’s own en-suite, full bath, and it’s own entrance via the garage, for example. There’s an additional room (not one of the bedrooms) that could either be a home-office or nursery, or…? Bathrooms, kitchens, floors, lighting, AC, irrigation and ceiling fans have all been upgraded. The roof is fewer than 2 years old. For those looking for future options, think about a cottage/ohana in the back, a 2nd story, etc…There really are so many possibilities.County water and sewer. It’s ready to go.
